attributes.name: split section content pairing
attributes.definition: What kind of content occupies each side of a two-column split section.

values.definition: One column holds text/heading and the other holds a card, image, or card group.
Sections are not split into two columns.
Two-column split with a different content pairing.

attributes.name: text column alignment and extras
attributes.definition: How the text column in a split section is aligned and whether it includes a call-to-action.

values.definition: Left column holds left-aligned heading and body text with no button.
Left column holds heading plus an outlined call-to-action button.
Left column holds just a heading, beside a grid of items.
No text column treatment is asserted.

attributes.name: visual column format
attributes.definition: The form of the non-text column in a split section.

values.definition: A single large image fills the column.
A multi-card grid (e.g. 2x2) of dark boxed cards.
One or more cards, unspecified styling or arrangement.
Either a card or image, not further specified.
